"""Parser for Meridian CRM 4.2 audited-column configuration files."""

from __future__ import annotations


def audited_columns(cfg_text: str) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
    """Return explicitly configured audited columns grouped by table.

    Comments are lines whose first non-whitespace character is '#'. Blank
    lines are ignored. All other lines must be exactly:

        AUDIT <TABLE> <COLUMN>
    """
    result: dict[str, set[str]] = {}

    for line_number, line in enumerate(cfg_text.splitlines(), start=1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue

        tokens = line.split()
        if len(tokens) != 3 or tokens[0] != "AUDIT":
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid audit configuration line {line_number}: {line!r}"
            )

        _, table, column = tokens
        result.setdefault(table, set()).add(column)

    return result
